title: Faster planning decisions as new rules and AI tackle delays
author: UK Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
date_note: 页面日期10月30日，正文提10月31日实施；不以抓取today替代日期，列近期回顾。
read_scope: 官方正文L53-112；未独立审计试点数据。
quote: Planning officers remain responsible for reviewing applications and making decisions.
observation: 官方介绍PlanAssist汇集申请、政策与场地约束，并扩大至15个地方政府试点；决定仍由规划人员负责，非面向本用户开放的制作工具。
